160%E2%9F%A7+g%7D%E2%80%94preserve+the+same+information+at+a+fraction+of+the+token+cost+and+with+substantially+faster+memory+availability%2C+offering+a+more+memory-efficient+and+operationally+responsive+representation.%0A%0A%23%23+5+Conclusion+and+Future+Work%0A%0A
